Win in [[Guild versus Guild]].

==Quest information==
===Objectives===
* Win 1 rated GvG battle.
* *BONUS* Win a round of GvG in an [[Automated Tournament]].
* *BONUS* Win 3 rated GvG battles.
* See [[Zehnchu]] <nowiki>[</nowiki>[[Zaishen]] Challenge] for your reward.

===Reward===
*1,500 [[Gold]]
*9,000 [[Balthazar Faction]]
*Complete the Base Objective for 50 [[Copper Zaishen Coin|Zaishen Copper Coins]].
*Complete the first *BONUS* Objective for an additional 100 Zaishen Copper Coins.
*Complete the second *BONUS* Objective for an additional 200 Zaishen Copper Coins.

==Dialogue==

===Initial dialogue===
;Zaishen Combat
:''"Build your guild team of eight and battle another guild. Return victorious to Zehnchu to claim [[Balthazar]]'s reward."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I can do that!
| decline = No, I'm way too busy today.
| ask = More competitors needed to prove their mettle in combat. Travel to the battlegrounds if you have what it takes to triumph.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Zehnchu
:''"Excellent work! The Zaishen admire your dedication."''
